emotional_tone: Warm, elegant, professional, trustworthy, authentically Cameroonian.

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Use bold/black weights for impact, or light weights for elegance.
Maintain a 2-step tailwind scale max between heading and subheading.
Never use pure black (#000000); use deep forest/charcoal (#2B3A2C).
Ensure WCAG AA contrast, especially for primary buttons.
Hover states must be explicitly defined and accessible.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but generously applied (e.g., p-8, p-12, py-24).
layout_and_spacing.marketing_pages: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (asymmetrical, wide gap-8 to gap-12, col-span mixing).
layout_and_spacing.dashboards: Control Room Grid (dense, gap-4 to gap-6, cardless or sharp 1px borders, h-full stretching).
rules: Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

components.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for asymmetric, overlapping bento grids.
components.interactive_elements: Use heavily customized Shadcn UI (Forms, Select, Dialog).
components.dashboards: Flat surfaces, minimal shadows, 1px subtle borders (border-border), dense data display.
components.cards: For e-commerce products: simple border-collapse or 1px border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg.
components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-border/50. Must always have navigation visible on desktop.
components.footer: Massive space (py-20), dark background if page is light, with large typographic brand mark.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements.
Smooth transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react (already installed). Use varied stroke weights to match typography.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button').
accessibility.focus_states: Must have high contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).

rules: Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com.
Use the provided URLs below for MVP.

heroes_and_portraits.description: Smiling woman entrepreneur in yellow blazer - ideal for Vendor Landing Page Hero.
Confident woman in orange blazer - great for 'About Us' or testimonial sections.

products_fashion.description: Woman in colorful dress - use as fashion category cover.
Assorted African fabrics/wax patterns - ideal for generic product thumbnails or category backgrounds.

products_cosmetics.description: Natural cosmetics flatlay - use for cosmetics/beauty category.
Woman enjoying skincare routine - lifestyle image for beauty section.

products_crafts.description: Handmade brown wicker basket - use for artisanal/crafts category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON carefully. Strict adherence to the color palette (Terracotta/Ochre/Forest Green) is mandatory to capture the Cameroonian warmth without cliché pinks.
Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Ensure e-commerce product pages prioritize clean, white backgrounds for products, using the elegant typography specified.
Build the dashboard (Admin/Vendor/Client) using the 'Control Room Grid' spacing - tight, precise, cardless or 1px border.
For payments (MTN MoMo, Orange Money, Visa), build simulated UI flows in the checkout.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in your main index.html/CSS.
Ensure data-testid attributes are comprehensively added across all forms, buttons, and navigation elements.
